pages.text: Four tiers, decided by the controller block:$(li)Basic: rate x1.0, 1M capacity$(li)Advanced: rate x1.5, 5M capacity$(li)Super: rate x2.0, 20M capacity$(li)Ultimate: rate x3.0, 50M capacity$(br2)Higher tiers also boost the weight of rare ores (diamond, emerald, netherite scrap).

$(2,4)Output rules$(0)$(li)Consume Akaishi Energy to advance the mining progress$(li)When full, roll one vanilla ore by chance$(li)Fortune upgrades increase the output count$(li)Ores are pushed into the Port's 27-slot buffer$(br2)Ores: coal, iron, copper, gold, redstone, lapis, quartz, diamond, emerald and netherite scrap.
